Hi all,

I'm submitting the endorsement packet for Sanjay Kumar (IC, Platform infra) for Senior Engineer. The write-up and evidence excerpts are attached — the bundle has anonymized customer excerpts and a short note from the candidate's tech lead.

As this is a sensitive packet (candidate has an ongoing support rotation in a regulated account), I'd like to request that the packet be hand-carried to the committee rather than published to the broader promotion queue. Practically that means:
- Committee reviewers below (Laura/Aditya/Markus) receive the full packet by direct email.
- People Ops will hold the canonical copy in a restricted Drive folder.
- We run a conflict/recusal check and confirm any quiet-window exemptions before wider circulation.

Requested next steps:
1) Please confirm by EOD Monday (5/17) whether you have any conflicts with Sanjay or Michael Grant (his manager, cc'd).
2) If no conflicts, please identify a 30–40 minute slot next week for a compact review — my preference is Thu (5/20) or Fri (5/21) morning PT.
3) If you want redlines to the write-up, reply inline; I'll produce a revised PDF.
